products.name: Acme CRM Cloud

products.howItHelps: Gives sales leaders one forecast and cuts manual reporting.

products.name: Acme Service Desk
products.whatItIs: Omnichannel case management with a self-service portal.
products.howItHelps: Shortens resolution times and deflects routine tickets.

products.name: Acme Field Service
products.whatItIs: Scheduling, dispatch and a mobile app for field technicians.
products.howItHelps: Raises first-time fix rates and technician utilization.

products.name: Acme Analytics
products.whatItIs: Self-service dashboards and AI forecasting on Acme and external data.
products.howItHelps: Turns operational data into decisions without a BI team.

products.name: Acme Data Pipelines
products.whatItIs: Managed connectors that sync ERP, billing and warehouse data.
products.howItHelps: Removes custom integration work when systems or entities are added.

products.name: Acme Billing
products.whatItIs: Subscription billing, invoicing and revenue recognition.
products.howItHelps: Handles multi-entity and multi-currency billing as companies expand.

products.name: Acme Secure Identity
products.whatItIs: Single sign-on, MFA and user provisioning for Acme and third-party apps.
products.howItHelps: Speeds onboarding of new hires and reduces access risk.

products.name: Acme Legacy Reports
products.whatItIs: Scheduled static reports, replaced by Acme Analytics.
products.howItHelps: Kept for existing customers until migration.
